Contraindicated [nitroglycerin:contraindications:0].

Nitroglycerin is contraindicated in patients taking phosphodiesterase type 5 (PDE-5) inhibitors such as sildenafil [nitroglycerin:contraindications:0]. Concomitant use of these agents has been shown to potentiate the hypotensive effects of organic nitrates [nitroglycerin:drug_interactions:0], which can lead to severe hypotension, syncope, or myocardial ischemia [nitroglycerin:contraindications:0].
